children: ISFIYA, Israel and LAS VEGAS, Sept. 09, 2026
MBody AI Ltd. ("MBody AI" or the "Company")

today announced that it has successfully completed a Proof of Concept deployment of its autonomous robotic systems at Mohegan Sun, one of North America’s largest casino and entertainment destinations. The pilot robots have remained in service at Mohegan Sun and switched to a paid commercial agreement since the pilot concluded. Mohegan Sun located in Uncasville, Connecticut, is a 5.5 million-square-foot resort that ranks among the largest integrated entertainment resorts in the United States, with 1,600 hotel rooms, two unique casinos, a 10,000-seat award-winning arena, and 275,000 square feet of convention and meeting space operating around the clock, 365 days a year.

During the pilot deployment, MBody AI deployed autonomous robots across two of the most demanding environments in hospitality: the gaming floor and the conference center. The robots operated through full day and evening shifts, handling repetitive and time-sensitive tasks so that Mohegan Sun staff could focus on higher-value, guest-facing work. Following strong results in the pilot deployment, Mohegan Sun has indicated it will expand the number of robots under a muti-year subscription agreement later this year.

The deployment is managed by the MBody AI Orchestrator™, the company’s hardware-agnostic platform for coordinating diverse robot fleets across sites and use cases. The anticipated expansion would make Mohegan Sun one of MBody AI’s larger single-property gaming deployments and reflects the company’s strategy of converting successful pilots into standing commercial operations.

"MBody’s technology has transformed our daily operations. We can rely on it to do high quality, safe work throughout the day and evening, while my staff can focus on higher-value jobs. We look forward to continuing to work with MBody and to exploring other opportunities to bring technology to Mohegan Sun for the betterment of our guests and team members," said Melissa Benoit, Director of Housekeeping and EVS, Mohegan Sun.

"Mohegan Sun holds an extremely high bar for their guests' experience, and our technology proved it could adapt to one of the most demanding environments in hospitality. The pilot generated strong data that supports expansion, and it is the model we intend to repeat across every property we enter," said John Fowler, Chief Executive Officer of MBody AI.

develops enterprise software that deploys and manages autonomous robot workforces for hospitality and gaming operators.
